notes.title: Demo version released!
notes.notes:
In principle, almost everything I wanted to implement in the demo version was successful. Therefore, I decided to release it a little earlier than the start of Steam Next Fest. Now everyone will have time to play :)

By the way, here is one of the places that can be found in the snowy desert.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41047343/363b25c9dd5ccaac4a227c9e3d08f9a31b6b7324.png

Do not forget that the game is still in development, and not all functions have yet been implemented. In fact, this is not only a demo, but also a beta testing version.

If bugs are found, please write to the community :)
